{"consolidated_memory":"## Flapping Flag Incidents in platform/featureflags/eval.go

### Incident 1: [2026-04-02] – Missing Composite Index
**Component:** platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)  
**Problem:** Flapping flag in the flag evaluator  
**Trigger/Scope:** Sessions arriving through OAuth provider  
**Reproduction:** Evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly  
**Root Cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)  
**Error Signal:** Decision alternates between calls  
**Outcome:** Error rate dropped from 4.2% to under 8 per ten thousand  
**Fix:** Added composite index and backfilled in batches  
**PR/Branch:** #1210 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1  
**Context:** Same area as earlier flapping flag work in eval.go

### Incident 2: [2026-07-20] – Schema Drift Between Migration and Model
**Component:** platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)  
**Problem:** Flapping flag in the flag evaluator  
**Trigger/Scope:** Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket  
**Reproduction:** Evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly  
**Root Cause:** Schema drift between migration and model  
**Error Signal:** Decision alternates between calls  
**Outcome:** Job finished in 29 minutes instead of 9 hours  
**Fix:** Regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum  
**PR/Branch:** #7726 on branch fix/flapping-flag-7  
**Context:** Same area as earlier flapping flag work in eval.go

Both incidents occurred in the same component corner but stem from different underlying causes and affected different user populations."}
